name: Morgan Le Fay
title: Fae Sorceress
summary: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: Ambitious half-sister of Arthur, rival of Merlin, Morgan le Fay stands among Avalon’s most potent sorcerers. Between her magics and her many plots, she has nearly overthrown Camelot countless times, and even the Shattering has not blunted her efforts. Her most intricate plan has her cooperating with Koshchei the Deathless across realms, but even this represents but one of many ongoing schemes.
archetype_description: Increase on hit damage by 1% for each piece of leather armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: Chance to place at random [Aetherburn II], [Blaze II], or [Acid] on the target for 3 turns, or 2 stacks of [Bleed] instead.
If an enemy has all 4 Debuffs removed, place [Banish] on them for 2 turns.
Each time an enemy Debuff activates, increase this hero’s ACC by 10 (up to 20 times).
